name: Enron Task Force
blurb: A sandboxed explorer over thousands of Enron emails, resolved into one identity graph. Cross-inbox aliases collapse to canonical people and companies; counterparty centrality is graph degree, the collapse is a timeline, and every relationship cites its source email — no inference.

name: Atlas Explorer
blurb: A generic explorer over any corpus's atlas — entities, the arguments they make, open questions, and the source behind each. Bound to a corpus at launch.

name: The Federalist Papers
blurb: Explore the founding essays — the entities, the arguments, the open questions — each traceable to its source. A complete, working example you can copy to build a mesh app for your own corpus.

name: SF Land-Value Tax
blurb: A sandboxed explorer over the SF assessor roll. Every figure is computed by the host and cited — no model originates a number.

name: Today — current events, on your machine
blurb: Wikipedia's Current Events portal as a local, dated feed — every event linking into the encyclopedia you host. Refreshed daily by the newsworthy watcher; nothing fetched at read time.

name: Project Blue Book
blurb: A sandboxed explorer over the Air Force's UFO archive. The hotspot ranking and every edge are a deterministic fold over the investigation graph — each claim quotes its Form-10073 card.

name: Wrapped
blurb: A story-card show over your own conversation archive. Every number is computed on this machine by the host — no model originates a figure — and every quote is your own words, verbatim, cited back to the conversation it came from. Computed locally, uploaded nowhere.
